_about: Six design directions for XIOS/3 applications. Each is a complete token theme (seeds = colours, knobs = type, spacing and shape; the runtime derives hovers, borders, selection and muted text from the seeds) plus the voice of its status lines. scripts/designkit.py picks one from the app's purpose, or you name one. Every on-* colour was checked against its surface at 4.5:1 or better.

directions.name: Ledger
directions.for: finance, administration, back-office, inventory, CRM, anything with tables and numbers
directions.layout: list + detail with a left navigation rail; tables and totals; tabular numerals

voice.first_run: Your workspace is ready. Add the first record to begin.
voice.failed: Could not save. Check the connection and try again.

directions.name: Studio
directions.for: agencies, creative and project tools, boards, marketing, portfolios
directions.layout: cards on a soft background; a top bar with one primary action; board or list + detail

knobs.font-sans: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

voice.first_run: Welcome. Start with your first project; everything else grows from there.
voice.empty: No projects yet. Choose New project to add the first one.
voice.failed: That did not save. Try again, or reload the page.

directions.name: Clinic
directions.for: health, wellness, bookings and appointments, coaching, anything people use while stressed
directions.layout: generous spacing, rounded cards, one task per screen, large controls

voice.first_run: Hello. Your first booking is one tap away.
voice.empty: No bookings yet. The next one you add appears here.
voice.failed: Something went wrong while saving. Nothing was lost; please try again.

directions.name: Field
directions.for: trades, fleets, sites, inspections, logistics, farms: used outdoors, with gloves, in sunlight
directions.layout: big tap targets, one column on phones, strong status colours, little decoration

voice.failed: Not saved. No signal? It will not retry by itself; try again when you are back online.

directions.name: Night
directions.for: developer tools, monitoring, metrics, media, music, video, anything used for hours in a dim room
directions.layout: dark surfaces, one accent, monospace for identifiers, dense lists

knobs.font-mono: ui-monospace, 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

voice.first_run: Connected. Nothing to show until the first event arrives.

directions.name: Paper
directions.for: notes, courses, documentation, writing, journals, recipes, anything read more than clicked
directions.layout: a reading column of 65 characters, serif headings, generous line height, few borders

knobs.font-sans: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
knobs.font-display: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif

voice.first_run: A blank page. Start writing whenever you like.
voice.failed: Could not save. Your text is still on the screen; copy it before you reload.
